entry.name: jit.reverse
entry.digest: Reverse output with respect to input
entry.description: jit.reverse reverses the sequential order of data coming in its inlets, relative to its outlets; a jit.reverse object with 5 inlets will pass input sent to the left inlet to its rightmost outlet, pass inlet 2 data to outlet 4, and so on.
